chunks: The day when neither wealth nor children will be of any avail
ai.seo_question: What happens to wealth and children on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara (26:88) is often cited to emphasize the futility of worldly attachments on the Day of Resurrection, where neither wealth nor offspring can intercede for the individual. It underscores the principle that true salvation depends on sincere faith and righteous deeds, a core tenet in both Sunni and Shia eschatological teachings. The verse serves as a powerful reminder to prioritize spiritual growth over material accumulation.
